purpose: After all 1,781 signal-time charts and Phase-1 labels were frozen without outcomes, render the same anonymous events with independent post-signal panels, group them by four completed-trade outcome categories plus no-completed-trade, and review every chart. This is development attribution only; it cannot rewrite Phase-1 labels, create a trading rule, or authorize a replay.

scientific_boundary.claim: Phase 2 may describe how already-frozen signal-time morphology relates to coarse categorical outcomes and how paths unfold after the signal. It cannot claim independent confirmation or use a post-signal observation as an entry predictor.
scientific_boundary.later_years: All 2021-plus rows and outcomes remain closed. A later rule and any 2022-2024 read would require separate freezes and the user's annual count/mean-return gate.

frozen_stage_b_identity.execution: First legal open in global sessions +1 through +3; +10 percent target; strict H20 fallback; 40 bps round-trip signal-level cost.

coordinate_hash_boundary: The authorized runner may hash the complete immutable coordinate artifact after the joint CY-044 gate solely to verify its frozen byte identity. SQL row parsing remains hard-bounded to 2018-01-22 through 2020-12-31; hashing is not authorization to parse a post-2020 row.

chart_contract.contact_sheet_layout: 5 by 5; at most 25 anonymous charts per page, grouped by one frozen outcome bucket
chart_contract.pre_panel: Relative global sessions -126 through 0 with a per-event causal price and turnover scale.
chart_contract.post_panel: Relative global sessions +1 through +126 with a separate per-event price and turnover scale. Entry, +10-percent target and realized exit markers are attribution only.
chart_contract.visible_identity: Only chart_number and blind_chart_id; symbol, date, industry and event_id never appear in a published Phase-2 file or image.
chart_contract.review_requirement: Every occupied contact-sheet cell must be opened at original resolution and assigned exactly one post-path label; difficult cases use the individual PNG.
chart_contract.publication: Same-parent staging, exact hash revalidation, exactly-once anonymous coverage, atomic rename and overwrite refusal.

phase2_path_taxonomy.primary_attribution_window: Relative sessions +1 through +20, aligned with the frozen trade lifecycle. Sessions +21 through +126 remain visible six-month context but do not determine the primary label.

definitions.IMMEDIATE_ACCEPTANCE: A clear sustained upward response starts during +1 through +5 and remains accepted through the relevant H20 path or reaches the marked target without an earlier decisive rejection.
definitions.DELAYED_ACCEPTANCE: No clear immediate acceptance; after early basing or a recoverable pullback, a clear sustained upward response starts during +6 through +20.
definitions.EARLY_REJECTION: A clear sustained downside break begins during +1 through +5 and is not promptly reclaimed by +10.
definitions.LATE_REJECTION: No early rejection; the path is initially stable or favorable, but a clear sustained downside break begins after +5 and by +20.
definitions.CHOP_OR_AMBIGUOUS: The completed trade has no clear sustained acceptance or rejection in +1 through +20, or conflicting path evidence prevents one of the four directional labels.
definitions.NO_COMPLETED_TRADE: The frozen lifecycle status is not COMPLETED or its net return is nonfinite; this label is mandatory and cannot be reassigned from visual appearance.

phase2_path_taxonomy.use: Post-path labels explain realized development trajectories only. They may not be predictors or replace the Phase-1 signal-time labels.

prohibited: changing, relabeling or adjudicating a Phase-1 signal-time label after outcome reveal
using a post-signal path label, entry marker, target marker or exit marker as an entry predictor
numeric-return display, parameter search, candidate reselection, rule compression, rule aggregation or portfolio replay
opening later years because the mother population or one categorical diagnostic looks favorable
next_action: After CY-044 is registered, run only the bound renderer, review all 1,781 anonymous Phase-2 charts, and freeze the complete categorical ledger with the bound finalizer. A rule search remains unauthorized.
